brief.scope: Author independent tests for C1 worker frontend convergence and C2 adoption, using dispatch/task contracts and supplied review dispositions. Own only task/tests/test_run.py, task/tests/test_execution_frontend.py and dispatch/tests/test_execution_adoption.py under ops/devlane. Never read or author implementation. Test task vendor mode delegates to canonical launch with identical explicit selection, supervision/refusals/resume/results; preserve direct verify and stub replay. Cover optional commit transport, strict whole-catalogue duplicate decoding before dict collapse, complete reservations through admission/rendering, and OutputsError consistency. Use synthetic executors/fixtures with positive and faulty controls; no real vendor or state. Do not activate catalogue or invent policy/adapter interfaces. Report undeclared boundaries precisely. Run relevant tests against baseline, distinguish failures/errors, record hashes and commands. Clean Grok-only trailers; inline envelope.

findings.claim: Existing R1–R5 and R8–R15 classes still pin the dormant fileset/Popen vendor engine; C1 classes pin refuse-or-transfer at the frontend boundary. Direct verify and stub replay (R6/R7) stay. The later run.py compatibility producer cannot satisfy both sets without a test change, which that producer is denied.

The contracts name transfer at the frontend boundary and launch.py resume ID, but they do not name a public run.resume or run.canonical_launch callable. Tests freeze those two names so vendor mode can transfer without task importing dispatch or harness.

Extra adapter transport reservations have no public adapter interface in the accepted contracts. Tests pass reserved= into outputs_from_job, render_declared_outputs and append_declared_outputs, and pin launch default leaves last-message.json and COMMIT_MSG. No adapter.reservations or policy bind_launch/compile_launch was invented.
LaunchDeclarations.selection includes profile; the worker launch.py verb list does not name --profile. Identical-selection tests pin harness, model, effort, job and ref only.
